highlights:
# Rudus

Rudus is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Rudus automates concrete takeoffs to help estimators focus on bidding and win more projects. Rudus employs 2 people, founded in 2026. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff platform built exclusively for concrete and rebar subcontractors. We automate one of the most time-consuming part of your business so your estimators can bid more work, win more projects, and spend less time clicking through plan sheets. The result: up to 70% less time on takeoffs, 2-5× more bids without adding headcount, and fewer costly errors before they reach the field.

Product demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SnURbla7ZGI

## Company Details
- Industry: Technology, Information and Internet
- Type: Privately held
- Headquarters: San Francisco, United States
- Founded Year: 2026
- Homepage: rudus.ai
- Aliases: rudus
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/rudusai
- Linkedin Followers: 602
